verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server that lets users operate their workspace through natural language from AI platforms. Through it they can create and manage tasks and projects, search, generate reports, and in ChatGPT create and assign tasks or kick off projects, with confirmation UIs before changes are committed. Native in-product AI (AI Teammates, Asana Dash) is only described in marketing terms. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operation works as claimed, and documentation of a natural-language command interface inside Asana itself rather than through external AI clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Asana's official MCP server lets you interact with your Asana workspace through natural language—create tasks, search projects, analyze workload, and more—all from your preferred AI platform.
Create and manage tasks and projects through natural language
From a single ChatGPT conversation, you can check on portfolios, create and assign tasks, kick off new projects, and review work—all without switching between tools.
Interactive tools render a confirmation UI before committing a change. These are currently available in Claude and ChatGPT.
